meta.source: Warhammer Age of Sigmar 4th Edition Core Rules (official free download, warhammer-community.com)
meta.description: Structured AoS 4th core rules for the battle engine — turn sequence, commands, core mechanics

battleRound.priority: At the start of each battle round both players roll off (priority roll). The winner chooses who takes the first turn. A tie: whoever went second last round chooses (round 1: the player who finished deploying first chooses).
battleRound.commandPoints: Each player receives 4 CP at the start of the battle round. Unspent CP are lost at the end of the round.
battleRound.combatPhaseNote: In the Combat phase players alternate picking units to fight, starting with the active player. Units that charged do not automatically strike first — abilities grant Strike-first.

phases.hero: Use Hero-phase abilities: casting spells (WIZARD), chanting prayers (PRIEST), Rally command, faction hero-phase abilities. Both players have hero-phase windows — the active player resolves first.
phases.movement: Units can Move (up to Move characteristic), Run (+D6", cannot shoot or charge later that turn unless an ability allows it), or Retreat (leave combat — the unit suffers D3 mortal damage and cannot shoot or charge that turn). Flying models ignore terrain and other models while moving.
phases.shooting: Units with ranged weapons can shoot if eligible: not having Run or Retreated this turn. Units in combat can only shoot at enemy units in combat with them (Shoot in Combat weapons excepted).
phases.charge: A unit can charge if it is not in combat, did not Run or Retreat this turn, and is within 12" of an enemy. Charge roll is 2D6"; the move must end within 1/2" of an enemy unit.
phases.combat: Alternating activations starting with the active player. A unit fights if it is in combat (within 3" combat range) or charged this turn. When activated: pile in up to 3", then attack with melee weapons.
phases.end: Score end-of-turn objectives, resolve expiring abilities, tidy state.

commands.name: Rally
commands.effect: Pick a friendly unit not in combat. Roll 6 dice: each 4+ is a rally point. Spend rally points to heal wounds or return slain models to the unit.

commands.name: At the Double
commands.timing: Your Movement phase (when a unit Runs)
commands.effect: The unit's Run roll is treated as 6 instead of rolling.

commands.name: Forward to Victory
commands.timing: Your Charge phase (when a unit declares a charge)

commands.name: All-out Attack
commands.timing: Reaction: when you declare an Attack ability
commands.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for the attacking unit's attacks this phase.

commands.name: All-out Defence
commands.timing: Reaction: when your unit is targeted by an Attack ability
commands.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for the target unit this phase.

commands.name: Redeploy
commands.timing: Reaction: end of enemy Movement phase
commands.effect: Pick a friendly unit not in combat: it can move up to D6" (cannot end the move in combat).

commands.name: Covering Fire
commands.timing: Reaction: end of enemy Movement phase
commands.effect: Pick a friendly unit with ranged weapons: it shoots, but subtract 1 from its hit rolls.

commands.name: Counter-charge
commands.timing: Reaction: end of enemy Charge phase
commands.effect: Pick a friendly unit: it can attempt a charge as if it were your Charge phase.

commands.name: Magical Intervention
commands.timing: Reaction: end of enemy Hero phase
commands.effect: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST: it can use one spell or prayer as if it were your Hero phase (harder to cast — apply the penalty from the core rules).

commands.name: Power Through
commands.effect: After a unit with a higher Health characteristic than an enemy unit in combat with it fights, it can inflict mortal damage on that unit and then move through it.

commandLimits: Each command can only be used once per phase, and a unit can only be affected by one command per phase.

coreMechanics.attacks: Attack sequence: Hit roll (vs Hit characteristic) → Wound roll (vs Wound characteristic) → opponent Saves (modified by Rend) → Damage. Unmodified 6 to hit is a Critical Hit — weapon abilities like Crit (2 Hits), Crit (Auto-wound) and Crit (Mortal) trigger on it.
coreMechanics.wards: Ward saves: roll a dice per point of damage; on a success the damage is ignored. Wards cap at 3+ effectiveness by rule interactions; a unit uses only its best ward.
coreMechanics.mortalDamage: Mortal damage bypasses hit/wound/save sequences entirely (wards still apply).
coreMechanics.strikeOrder: Strike-first and Strike-last modify activation order in the Combat phase: all Strike-first units fight before normal units; Strike-last units fight after everything else. If both apply they cancel out.
coreMechanics.objectives: Objectives are controlled by comparing total Control characteristics of models within 3" (contesting range). Control is sticky in some battlepacks — check the active battlepack.
coreMechanics.combatRange: A unit is in combat while within 3" of an enemy unit. Pile-in moves are up to 3" and must end no further from the nearest enemy.
coreMechanics.battleshock: There is no battleshock phase in 4th edition — attrition is handled through control scores and abilities.
coreMechanics.terrain: Terrain features grant Cover (+1 to save against shooting for units wholly behind/on them, not if they charged) and may be Impassable, Obscuring or have faction terrain rules.
coreMechanics.magic: Casting: 2D6 vs the spell's casting value; enemy WIZARDS within range may unbind. Manifestations (endless spells and invocations) are summoned units controlled by abilities — they act in a dedicated step and can be banished.
coreMechanics.unitCoherency: Models in a unit must remain in coherency: within 1" horizontally of another model in the unit (2 models for units of 7+). Models out of coherency at the end of a turn are removed.

armyConstruction.points: Matched play: 2000 pts standard (Battlepack: General's Handbook). Armies pick one faction, one battle formation, heroic traits, artefacts of power and spell/prayer/manifestation lores per the battlepack limits.
armyConstruction.regiments: Armies are organised into regiments, each led by a HERO; the number of regiments and companion rules follow the battlepack.
armyConstruction.generalsHandbook: Season rules (battle tactics, objectives, restrictions) come from the current General's Handbook battlepack.

notes: This document is the engine summary; the verbatim rules are the free official PDF on warhammer-community.com
Spearhead (boxed small-format mode, the AoS equivalent of Combat Patrol) has its own bespoke rules per box — not yet ingested
Faction battle traits, formations and unit rules are data: AoS/Data/*.json → Supabase aos-4e
